title: Liber Adami (Mandaean Adam Traditions / Ginza Rba)

details.intro:
The Liber Adami of CAVT 15 designates the ancient Mandaic liturgical and mythological scriptures relating to Adam (*Adam Pagria* and *Adam Kasia*), preserved within the Ginza Rba (The Great Treasure) and the liturgical compendia edited by Matthias Norberg under the title Codex Nasaraeus, Liber Adami appellatus (1815–1816).

In Mandaean cosmology, Adam is created physically by the planetary powers (Ptahil and the Demonic Archons) but endowed with a divine soul (*Nishimta*) by the Supreme Life (*Hayyi Rabbi*) through the celestial messenger Manda d-Hayye. The work contains the revelations delivered to Adam regarding the nature of the cosmos, the journey of the soul through the planetary watch-houses (*mataratha*), and the secret baptismal rites (*masbuta*).
details.provenance:
Language: Eastern Aramaic (Mandaic).
Date: Late antiquity (3rd–7th century CE Mesopotamian traditions).
Setting: Mandaean baptismal communities of southern Iraq and Khuzestan.
details.manuscripts: • Manuscripts: Paris BN Mss. syr. 238, 239, 240 (Ginza); Bodleian Library MSS Mandaean 1, 2; British Library Add. 23598.
